# FRAMEWORK-IMPROVEMENTS — suggestions for cap-evolve itself (cross-run)

NOT about this capability or this run's result — about what cap-evolve the FRAMEWORK should change so FUTURE runs (any capability, any project) go better: a confusing prompt section, a missing tool, a file you wished existed, a gate that felt wrong. Optional most iterations; add an entry whenever something about the framework itself (not the task) got in your way or surprised you.

<!-- cap-evolve:framework-improvements-append-below -->

## cand_0001
- The failure summary line "`<tool>`: expected call was never made by the agent" is misleading when the tool WAS called but the call was rejected by input validation (pydantic). Several tasks here (25, 22, 17) showed this: the agent made the write call, it bounced on a schema error, and the scorer reported it as "never made". Suggest the summary distinguish "never attempted" from "attempted but errored (N times)" and surface the last env error string, so an optimizer isn't misled into treating a schema/arg defect as an action-stall.
- There was no Python interpreter with pydantic on PATH in the working dir (`/usr/bin/python3` lacks it); I had to locate a venv under `.cache/capevolve-ci/` to run the frozen models. A documented pointer to a runnable interpreter for local tool-body verification would speed the VERIFY-THE-FIX step.
- The working directory is gitignored relative to the run_suite repo, so `git diff` shows nothing for capability edits — fine once known, but briefly confusing when the instructions reference diff.patch artifacts. A one-line note that the harness snapshots files directly (not via git) would help.
